_doc: Techniques. bonuses are gained PER mastery level (qi_mult is additive to a 1.0 cultivation multiplier; attack/defense/max_hp/speed are flat combat stats). A technique whose element matches one of the character's spiritual roots gets element_affinity_bonus extra effect; a mismatched element gets element_mismatch_penalty less. Learned by using the manual_item. Practice xp to go from level L to L+1 = xp_base * xp_growth^(L-1); practice yields comprehension-scaled xp per day. activation (optional, forbidden secret arts): {lifespan_cost: years burned per use, days: buff duration, buff: {attack|defense|max_hp|speed: fraction added to that combat stat, 0.5 = +50%}}; activating takes no time and is refused if it would burn the last years of life. kind "method" = a main cultivation method: only ONE method is active at a time (CharacterData.main_method); its qi_rate multiplies qi gathered (the part above 1.0 is scaled by element affinity like bonuses) and its per-level bonuses apply only while it is the main method. max_realm (optional realm id, "" = no cap): past that realm the method is outgrown and its rate falls to method_over_cap_rate. starter_method is the method everyone uses until they learn/set another (must be mortal, uncapped, qi_rate 1.0 keeps old saves at their speed). Learning your first method makes it your main method; switching later takes method_switch_days.

techniques.name: Blood Demon Rage
techniques.description: A forbidden art that sets your blood essence aflame. For a month you fight like a demon; every use shortens your life.

techniques.name: Blood Shadow Flight
techniques.description: Burn a few years of blood essence to blur into a crimson afterimage. Favored by assassins and runaways.

techniques.name: Ten-Thousand Bones Armor
techniques.description: Wrap yourself in the resentful bones of the fallen. Nothing pierces it, but the dead take their toll in years.

techniques.name: Heaven-Devouring Burst
techniques.description: Detonate your life force in a single week of overwhelming power. Many who learn it never grow old.

techniques.name: Common Qi Gathering Method
techniques.description: The crude breathing every would-be cultivator starts with. It goes nowhere fast, but it never stops working.

techniques.name: Verdant Spring Method
techniques.description: Draw qi in the way roots draw water: patient, deep and unending. A sound foundation for wood cultivators, but it has nothing to teach past Foundation Establishment.

techniques.name: Ember Heart Method
techniques.description: Fan the ember beneath the navel until it never goes out. A common fire method; it burns bright and burns out at Foundation Establishment.

techniques.name: Still Lake Method
techniques.description: Let the mind lie as flat as a mountain lake and qi pools in it unbidden. A common water method, good up to Foundation Establishment.

techniques.name: Iron Marrow Method
techniques.description: Temper qi like a smith tempers iron: hammered into the marrow breath by breath. A common metal method, good up to Foundation Establishment.

techniques.name: Deep Loam Method
techniques.description: Sit as the earth sits and draw qi up from below. A common earth method, good up to Foundation Establishment.

techniques.name: Azure Cloud Heart Sutra
techniques.description: The Azure Cloud Sect's inner method: qi gathered like clouds over a peak, soft, vast and patient. Taught only to its own disciples; it carries them through Core Formation.

techniques.name: Golden Abacus Method
techniques.description: The Myriad Treasure Pavilion's method counts every breath like a coin and wastes none. Steady metal qi for stewards who live to Core Formation.

techniques.name: Blood Lotus Rebirth Scripture
techniques.description: Blood Lotus disciples sit in pools of blood and let it bloom inside them. Fast, fierce fire cultivation that reaches Core Formation, and the stains do not wash out.

techniques.name: Mountain-and-Sea Breathing Art
techniques.description: A hermit's art: breathe in like the mountain, out like the sea. Earth qi as heavy and unhurried as the peaks, good through Core Formation.

techniques.name: Nine Heavens Thunder Scripture
techniques.description: The lost inheritance of a sect that cultivated in the storm. Any root can bear it; few can bear the trial. It carries its heir to Nascent Soul.

techniques.name: Myriad Corpse Devouring Canon
techniques.description: A canon written by a corpse-refining patriarch: draw qi from the dead and the dying, any element, any source. Vile, and frighteningly fast, all the way to Nascent Soul.

techniques.name: Basic Breathing Method
techniques.description: The first method taught to every outer disciple. Slow, steady and universal.

techniques.name: Flowing Water Sutra
techniques.description: Qi circulates like a river, never stagnant.

techniques.name: Blazing Sun Art
techniques.description: Swallow the sun's fire into the dantian. Fast and violent.

techniques.name: Iron Fist
techniques.description: A crude but honest boxing style. Every village has a master of it.

techniques.name: Metal Edge Sword Art
techniques.description: Sword qi as sharp as autumn frost.

techniques.name: Drifting Wind Step
techniques.description: Footwork that turns blows aside before they land.

techniques.name: Stone Skin Tempering
techniques.description: Temper flesh with earth qi until blades skid off it.

techniques.name: Cloud-Parting Palm
techniques.description: A gentle palm art of righteous sects: soft as mist on the way in, heavy as a tide when it lands.

techniques.name: Burning Cinder Fist
techniques.description: Every punch leaves embers in the wound. Loved by brawlers and hot-blooded young masters.

techniques.name: Verdant Vine Lash
techniques.description: Wood qi lashes out like a living vine, quick and hard to predict.

techniques.name: Immovable Mountain Stance
techniques.description: Root yourself to the earth's veins. Blows meant to kill only make you sway.

techniques.name: Golden Bell Shield
techniques.description: A Buddhist body art: qi rings around the skin like a temple bell, turning blades aside.

techniques.name: Scarlet Blood Palm
techniques.description: A demonic palm that boils the victim's blood. Strong from the first day, and it stains the soul of whoever practices it.

techniques.name: Nine Frost Sword Intent
techniques.description: Sword qi carries a killing frost; each of the nine forms is colder than the last.

techniques.name: Five Thunders Palm
techniques.description: Gather heaven's fire into the palm and release it as five rolling thunderclaps.

techniques.name: Thousand Fallen Leaves Step
techniques.description: Move like leaves in an autumn gale: a hundred afterimages, none of them where the blade lands.

techniques.name: Earth Dragon Body
techniques.description: Temper bones with the earth's dragon veins until the body is as heavy and enduring as a mountain range.

techniques.name: Corpse Qi Claw
techniques.description: Claws of grave-cold corpse qi that rot whatever they tear. A favorite of demonic cultivators who haunt old battlefields.

techniques.name: Azure Heaven Sword Canon
techniques.description: The lost canon of an ancient sword sect. The sword becomes an extension of the heart, and the heart of the sky.

techniques.name: Soul-Rending Demon Finger
techniques.description: A single finger that pierces the soul rather than the flesh. Righteous sects kill anyone known to practice it.
